info.description: Distributed Inference For All coordinator prototype. Fake runtime only.
info.title: DIFA Coordinator

post.description: Rotates credentials and revokes sessions and API keys; issues a new recovery code (spec 6.5).
Visibility changes create a new branch with immutable visibility (FR 18).
One-time code a member gives to the agent on their own device (spec 6.3 headless flow).
Agents report capabilities and their locally enforced state; the response renews the lease.

patch.description: Owners set limits; administrators may only disable. Agents also apply local ceilings (FR 07).

post.description: Local bootstrap only: the coordinator host creates the group (FR 01).
Plan with the filter-and-score pipeline, then load (FR 13, FR 14, FR 31).

delete.description: Revokes sessions, credentials, and devices and cancels queued and running work (FR 04).

get.description: Content-free queue view for administrators: positions and states, never prompts.

post.description: Shows the group name and fingerprint before joining (FR 03). Discloses no content.

get.description: Owner-scoped event stream with replay from Last-Event-ID (spec 9.3).
